data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the meter gateway (for example an RS485-to-TCP converter).
data_description.port: TCP port of the DLMS gateway (often 4059).
data_description.serial: Serial number printed on the electricity meter. Used to identify this meter in Home Assistant.
data_description.entity_type: Optional text appended to sensor names so several meters stay distinguishable. Use Default when only one meter is configured.
data_description.username: DLMS client user name, if the meter requires authentication.
data_description.password: DLMS password for the user above.

reconfigure.title: Update meter connection
reconfigure.description: Change the gateway address for meter {serial}. The device, its entities and their history stay exactly as they are; only the connection is redirected.

data_description.host: New IP address or hostname of the meter gateway.
data_description.port: New TCP port of the DLMS gateway (often 4059).

error.entry_busy: This meter connection is currently starting up or shutting down. Please try again in a few seconds.

abort.wrong_meter: The meter at this address has a different serial number than the one configured here. Add it as a new integration entry instead.
abort.duplicate_meter_identity: This meter serial number is already used by another config entry. Remove the duplicate entry before reconfiguring this one.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll live measurements (voltage, power, energy...). Default 3, allowed range 3-3600.
data_description.diag_scan_interval: How often to poll slow-changing diagnostic/config values. Default 600, allowed range 60-86400.

invalid_number.message: Value for {key} must be a finite number.

invalid_frequency_range.message: Frequency limits must satisfy 0 < minimum < maximum <= 100 Hz.

invalid_voltage_range.message: Voltage thresholds must satisfy 0 <= grid outage threshold < minimum < maximum <= 500 V.

invalid_voltage_hysteresis.message: Voltage hysteresis must leave a valid recovery range: hysteresis >= 0, outage threshold + hysteresis <= minimum, and 2 x hysteresis < maximum - minimum.

invalid_power_limit.message: Each active power limit must be a finite number greater than 0 W.

invalid_power_hysteresis.message: Power hysteresis must be at least 0 W and less than the smallest active power limit.
